notes.title: Familiar Travels - Free to Own Forever!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Familiar Travels? More like.. Freemiliar Public Transportels![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Starting September 1st, Familiar Travels Volume One will be completely FTP![/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]Halftone Studios, in its infancy of reforming and slowly working on/releasing new, small scale visual novel projects has decided to release the first chapter of Familiar Travels completely free to own, forever.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]At the moment, Halftone Studios is spread to the nine-winds, a few projects having fizzled out and everyone starting and stopping new lives, in this crazy world it's hard to keep things together, so I (rose) am focusing my efforts on creating small projects, with similar writing/storytelling/music as Familiar Travels, there's no real release date on that, but I'll be posting updates on one place, 

[url="https://bsky.app/profile/voidroses.bsky.social" style="button" buttoncolor="#e84874"]My Bluesky[/url][/p][p]I don't really post a lot on there, or use social media in general. So.. if you follow me you will not be subjected to too much random posting. The attention from Familiar Travels and subsequent public things was a bit much for my kitty brain so I prefer.. locking myself away in a cabin and writing until something is done, I am not suuuper great at community stuff, but if you ever reach out to me either there, or on discord (void_roses) we can talk![/p][p][/p][p]The other place that will be updated is the HalftoneStudios itch account
[url="https://halftonestudios.itch.io/" style="button" buttoncolor="#ec5c2d"]Our Itch[/url][/p][p][/p][p]I have no plans on making chapter two free at the moment, but there's tons of stuff in chapter one guys![/p][p]
So yes, Familiar Travels will be going free to play! I hope  you enjoy that!
Chapter Two on such platforms as itch will be adjusted price wise accordingly as well, so a reduce of 50% for that.. Yah![/p][p][/p][p]If you have any questions for me or the studio, your best bet is discord or Bluesky! 


tl;dr - Familiar Travels Chapter One is free, we are working on small games with even smaller teams, follow us for updates, message us for any reason.[/p]

notes.title: New Game Announcement!
notes.notes:
I’m happy to announce Halftone Studios latest project

Hyper Dimensional Basement Crawler

With the artistic stylings of TwoCups, the coding prowess of our own Kalvin Steelhorn and the music of Ben Agaric we are presenting to you an Alpha prototype of the game showcasing the engine, movement, and basic features for free, today! Head over to our itch.io page and check out our game. We’re going to be developing this game very publicly, with the help and feedback of the community to make the final version something everybody will love.

Join Familiar Travels protagonist Finley in the day before everything goes to hell. Explore the meticulously designed Po’s Emporium and chat with your favorite characters. 

Check the game out here, rate it, comment, and provide feedback in the discord server! We will be posting development diaries and engaging with the community while we work on a build for commercial release.

The core gameplay is going to be a roguelike RPG where you explore the mystical magical caverns beneath Vanaheim and beyond as you collect lost items for the various citizens of Vanaheim, supplying them to the shop and upgrading your character through a dynamic and evolving story. With heavy influence from the roguelikes of the day as well as more RPG focused dungeon crawlers like Pokemon Mystery Dungeon we hope to provide a unique take on the genre with a compelling story and an involved dynamic gameplay experience.

Download the alpha now and join our discord server to provide feedback, theorize, or just chat with the team! Download the Game here: https://halftonestudios.itch.io/hdbc

And our discord here!
https://discord.gg/KF7rKv8xqX

notes.title: MAJOR Familiar Travels content update!
notes.notes:
[b]MAJOR Familiar Travels content update![/b]

Familiar Travels has received its final major update which provides a new gameplay mode for people who are struggling to obtain the character endings, or don't want to play every character arc to receive the true ending.

Novel Mode!

Novel Mode is not only a novel difficulty for gameplay, but is also in line with the traditional "visual novel" format, hence the name.

Novel Mode features saving, and all the features you would expect, the major difference being the stories play out one after another, linearly, you can access the new novel mode from the main menu.

Some other updates include:
A viewable gallery from the main menu "extras" menu upon completion of the true ending (either in novel mode or regular mode)
Several minor scenes have been added to character's arcs that previously were hidden or very difficult to access. 
A whole bunch of bug fixes, music has been added in scenes where it was otherwise quiet, things like that.

I hope you enjoy Novel Mode, and if you found yourself frustrated at not obtaining the character ending you like, give it a shot, it'll allow you to experience the story and get involved with the rest of the community.



In addition to this update, we  have decided to release Chapter One (with it's own bug fixes and version of novel mode) for 90% Off!

notes.title: Release Build - Familiar Travels Chapter One
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544098/ac7d1f1a78bef828a09f21951c40dc9d48c5f8be.png[/img]

Alright Balin, I hear you say, what's so special about this build?

We’ve improved animations, we’ve improved scene transitions and music and just about everything, we’re snuck in a bunch of extra scenes and easter eggs! If you’ve been waiting for a definitive build of Familiar Travels to snag to experience the game as it’s intended to be, this is that build.

So, I’d like to summarize this build and the chapter two development with a less corporate, more personal letter:

[i]This has been an incredible month since the launch of the game. It’s been a bit of a bumpy launch, I remember telling someone else on the team that if we could just iron out some bugs for a month I’d be happy - But the support all of you guys have given in the development of the game, from giving me feedback (BTW, all of the feedback on the Steam page that was feasible to be added has been added) to joining in and engaging with the community. It’s been seriously inspiring and has put a lot of fuel in the entire team’s tanks for chapter two.
[/i]
Okay, let’s talk features.

A lot of this game’s mechanics were coded from the ground up, so perhaps a lot of features typical VNs would have innately we had to integrate in a way that wouldn’t break the game. In other words, with this patch we’ve added

[list]
[*] Auto Text Advance
[*] Fast Forward / Skip
[*] Backlog
[/list]

These are awarded to the player as they’re leaving the tutorial/intro section of the game, so  you’ll be all good with this one. I understand to a lot of people these are basic mechanics, apologies for not having them at launch, but we wanted to make sure they were fluid, non-laggy and precise.

Speaking of the intro section, we’ve re scripted a good section of the intro, polished it and added things that I feel improve the pacing a lot!

We have a route list on our discussion page, and there will be a small update coming after the sale to integrate Steam API (Screenshots, achievements, etc) and I’ll always be in there cleaning up the odd wrong letter or apostrophe ;)

The nice things you guys have said about the game means a lot to me, and I hope I can continue to do you proud as a developer, and I hope Halftone Studios can continue to be a crew you can get behind!

Don’t forget to join our discord server to participate in our community, and I hope all of you enjoy!

notes.title: Bonus Content, Bug Fixes, and More!
notes.notes:
It's here!

I mean, all of this stuff probably should have been here a little bit earlier but.. I'm happy to say I've taken all of the helpful suggestions and critiques from everyone who's played the game and applied a thick coat of polish over Chapter One, as well as a bunch of new scenes! 
So, here's the changelog.

[b]

== Bug Fixes ==
[list]
[*] - Grammar and Textbox Fixes Galore
[*] - You can now access your phone before Night Two, including settings, save/load etc.
[*] - Fixed a minor bug with background audio carrying over
[*] - Updated the introduction cutscene to have balanced audio and removed that.. green thing.
[*] - Time inconsistencies with the background characters have been removed
[*] - Removed every route error (textboxes vanishing, scenes locking up, etc)
[*] - Fixed a bug where Kaj's ending couldn't be accessed
[*] - Fixed invisible NPCs
[*] - Fixed a bug where the game would launch windowed (Is there interest in a windowed mode? Let me know!)
[*] - Sleeping on your couch now works as intended
[*] - Locations have the appropriate Day/Night backgrounds and sprites
[*] - Events all trigger at the proper times
[*] - Just a whole bunch of other bug fixes!
[*] - Seriously like 175 of them...
[/list]

== Content ==
[list]
[*] - Every character is now doing something every day (with minor exceptions)
[*] - A full route map is uploaded (Check out the community page -> Guides)
[*] - Just a whole bunch of new scenes, refer to the content map..
[/list][/b]

This is a big update and it wouldn't be possible without the help of everyone on the discord server, especially Barbsd and AKrowz who filled out the vast majority of the bug reports list, and all of you who helped me out with this stuff! Work is now officially resuming on chapter two so.. stay tuned for that!

Be sure to join our discord server at
discord.gg/familiartravels

notes.title: NEW BUILD!
notes.notes:
First things first, thank you for everyone who joined our discord server and helped report bugs. Although we have a diverse team of talented writers, composers, and artists, I am the only developer for the game so had a bit of a tough time getting through some of these bugs.

I have added a day indicator at the start of each day and night, fixed the looping with every route, and added some QOL updates. In other words, the game is completely playable from start to finish. This is really the standard of quality that should have came out on release, and I deeply apologize for that not being the case.

I imagine there still may be minor glitches and typos in the game, and any help with spotting those in our discord server is appreciated.

Rest assured the second part won't be released until we are 100% stable and polished.

Thank you all for your patience, and I hope you enjoy the game!
